wet.boundary: Race entry did not reach driving or briefing. Later DOM snapshots prove material compilation returned and the first chase warmup stage began. No completion of the first chase draw, pit-service warmup or GPU-completion gate is recorded.

codeFindings.finding: The ordinary requestAnimationFrame path returns while state is loading, before normal scene drawing. An unintended normal loading-frame draw is not supported by this path.

The first physics snapshot resolves readiness before renderer.prepare. Both warm traces reach this preparation phase; circuit construction and worker readiness are not their first unreached boundaries.
setCars constructs full FormulaCar objects. prepare builds these fallback roots before BikeShells.update builds GP models and hides Formula roots.
Each bike entry constructs high/mid/far models plus a service rig; update hides the corresponding Formula root. Later warm-run loading labels show this stage was passed.
Preparation compiles the whole live scene before the first chase draw. The next explicit draw is inside the chase/cockpit warmup loop, not the ordinary loading rAF.
compileSceneTarget preserves render-target state and calls renderer.compileAsync(scene,camera). It does not currently narrow compilation to GP-owned visible/required vehicle subtrees.

Three compile uses scene.traverse, not traverseVisible, for renderable materials. Hidden Formula/RB19 roots and inactive bike LODs/service rigs therefore remain in whole-scene shader preparation. compileAsync first calls compile synchronously, then polls program readiness.
Shadow-caster warmup returns immediately when renderer.shadowMap.enabled is false. The low preset recorded in these traces has shadowSize=0, which renderer.setQuality maps to disabled shadow maps.

actionableInference.dry: Whole-scene material compilation is the leading code-supported cost candidate after the final recorded graphics label. The trace lacks a stack or returned preparation receipt after that label, so this is not a proved per-material root cause.
actionableInference.wet: The later boundary is first chase scene warmup, followed by a target-crash report. Compilation alone cannot explain the wet observation because its compilation phase completed.
actionableInference.targetedInvestigation: Assess excluding only confirmed-hidden Formula/RB19 fallback roots from GP compilation while preserving all GP LODs, circuit/environment, required pit material warmups, original draws and deadlines. Separately inspect first-chase submission/completion and browser crash diagnostics; do not infer OOM from Target crashed alone.

acceptance.isolatedCourseResult: Parent reports separate final-source course fixture passed; it does not replace these incomplete full-game journeys.
acceptance.errorsQualification: No recorded page/console/HTTP errors is not a completed graphics acceptance result; wet has a recorded Playwright target-crash error.

coldComparison.scope: Prefinal source, before board-face depth and concrete-backing corrections.
coldComparison.boundary: Circuit construction before renderer publication; outer 300000 ms deadline expired.
coldComparison.distinction: Both final-source warm attempts progressed further and failed the inner 180000 ms entry predicate. They must not be merged with the earlier cold result or attributed to later geometry changes.

limits: The last returned diagnostics precede later loading DOM/pixel evidence; they are stale with respect to the final reached stage.
No CPU stack, GPU crash dump, complete post-stage preparation receipt or shader-cache-hit measurement is available in the inspected traces.
The traces do not establish that the new boards, covers, rider materials or GP-R2 bodywork caused either failure. The selected full-game bike was GP-R1.
No timeout, assertion, visible workload or source file was changed during this diagnosis.
